chunks: What al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurara, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever was granted protection by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, his diyyah is complete.

key_terms.ذِمَّةً: protected covenant or guarantee of protection
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: the Messenger of Allah, whose grant of protection carries legal authority
key_terms.فَدِيَتُهُ: his blood money or legal indemnity
key_terms.كَامِلَةٌ: complete, meaning full and not reduced

ai.seo_question: What is the diyyah of a person granted dhimmah by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a person who has been granted dhimmah by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It establishes that such a person's blood money is complete, indicating full legal compensation in this context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5255 - Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurara, from Abu Abdullah (as) who said: "
Whoever was granted protection (dhimmah) by Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family), his blood money (diyyah) is complete (to that of a muslim)."
